messages:
incident-bot: Automated page: RegionalFailoverDetector triggered 2026-03-15 12:34 UTC. Detected sustained failover from eu-central -> us-east (failover pct 18%, sustained 3m). Paging SEV-2.
Alex S.: Paging @Mei C. (EU oncall) 1: can you take? dashboard shows cross-region route shift + spike in 5xx for inference-router.
Mei C.: I'm oncall, ack. Looking at logs now. eu-central proxy errors look like connection timeouts to kv-store. Opening live tail.
Jordan L.: Grafana view: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/region/health-multi?panel=failovers 1 panel 'failover % by origin' currently eu-central -> us-east 18%. Also seeing increased retry loop causing traffic amplification.
Ravi M.: Observed dedicated pool saturation in eu-central: replica queue depth 520, GPU util 99%. There were two recent deploys in eu-central 6m ago. Any rollout?
Mei C.: Confirmed replicas restarting; logs show OOM on model-worker during long sequences. Rolling back last deploy in eu-central now.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for rollout eu-central/rls-2026-03-15-06.
Alex S.: While rollback runs, let's enable soft-failover policy to avoid aggressive reroutes. Also prune low-priority batch traffic to KV to relieve pressure.
Mei C.: Applying ingress rate-limit for batch group via k8s network policy:
```
kubectl apply -f /infra/limits/eu-central-batch-throttle.yaml
```
alert-bot: Executing action: mute alert "kv-latency-eu-central" for 20m by Mei C. Reason: active mitigation during rollback.
Mei C.: Muted. Also reducing paging noise: creating a composite alert rule that requires failover > 15% AND cluster-5xx > 0.4% before paging oncall.
Jordan L.: Strong +1 for composite. Current single-metric pages caused a lot of churn during last week's rollout. Drafting alert PR. Will include a dashboard panel 'origin->dest traffic shift' and 'failover heatmap'.
Ravi M.: After applying throttle and rollback, kv latencies dropped from 1.8s -> 750ms and 5xx rate decreased. Failover pct trending down to 6% over last 4m.
Alex S.: Customer impact: some customers in eu-central saw latency degradation for ~9 minutes; no request data lost, SDK retries handled most failures. Notifying CS with a short blurb.
Mei C.: Capturing mitigation steps in incident doc: rollback, throttle, burst-capacity toggle (not needed after rollback). Adding owners for follow-ups: alert-tuning (Jordan), autoscale-config (Ravi), deploy-rollback-cause (Mei).
Jordan L.: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pulls/427 1 composite rule + new panels. Tagging @Alex S. for priority review.
Alex S.: Approved. Please ensure new panel includes per-region failover latency and origin/destination flows.
Mei C.: On-call handoff: I'll stay for 20m then hand to @Jordan L. with checklist: current kv latency 730ms, failover 6%, muted alerts list, rollout rollback in progress.
Jordan L.: Acknowledged. I'll monitor the 'sustained-failover' metric and unmute alerts after stability window. Also drafting a low-noise alerting mode for planned cross-region rollouts that routes to rollout-channel instead of full page.
Ravi M.: Follow-up note: autoscaler observed CPU bumps due to a regression in batch controller. Adding autoscale policy change to post-incident board.
Alex S.: Action items summarized: 1) merge composite alert PR (Jordan), 2) update autoscale thresholds and test (Ravi), 3) RCA on deploy causing OOM (Mei), 4) CS customer impact note + list of impacted orgs (Alex).
incident-bot: Incident status changed to 'stabilized' at 12:40 UTC; severity downgraded to SEV-3. Incident timeline will be auto-generated.
Mei C.: Thanks team. Small win on muting the noisy single-metric pages; let's keep the composite rule as default for region failovers. Passing monitoring to Jordan. :thumbsup:
Jordan L.: Taking over monitoring. Will follow up with a short postmortem doc and schedule the alert tuning change for immediate merge.
